representation_manifest.profile_description: Neutral automatic Codex context with complete local recovery and no pre-action advice.

spec.title: Subjective revision
spec.description: Select runtime, session, cursor, epoch, and active actor identity.

omission_contract.rationale: Automatic context needs decision identity but not source-stream debugging cursors.

spec.description: Index known hazards, slow cells, blockers, and vision blockers.

omission_contract.rationale: The bounded turn view carries topology classes while exact tile records remain inspectable.

subjectivity_contract.description: Reads only the session-subjective local materialization and preserves explicit knowledge-state distinctions unless the omission contract says otherwise.

spec.description: Build a bounded non-ranking scene from known topology and contacts.

spec.description: Reproduce the current bounded recent subjective combat-log projection.

spec.title: Focused logical state
spec.description: Expose selected three-valued predicates without removing them from the complete ledger.

omission_contract.filtering_predicate: Predicate focus profile and change state.
omission_contract.rationale: Attention controls automatic exposure only; every evaluation remains in the ledger.

subjectivity_contract.description: Reads only the session-subjective local materialization and preserves explicit knowledge-state distinctions unless the omission contract says otherwise.

parameter_schema.description: Maximum focused predicate evaluations emitted automatically.
